title: High-entropy oxides as advanced anode materials for long-life lithium-ion Batteries

materials.name: (FeCoNiCrMn)3O4 HEO
materials.description: Prepared by oxidation of FeCoNiCrMn high-entropy alloy powder at 1000°C in oxygen atmosphere.

materials.name: (FeCoNiCrMn)3O4 BM
materials.description: Prepared by ball milling of oxide precursors (Fe2O3, NiO, Cr2O3, MnO2, Co3O4) followed by same heat treatment as HEO.

electrochemical_test_conditions.source_text: achieved a high reversible capacity of 596.5 mA h g^-1 and a good capacity retention of 86.2% after 1200 cycles at 2.0 A g^-1
Electrochemical performances were carried out on the LAND CT2001A multi-channel battery test system (0.01–3 V) at 25°C.

cell_assembly_conditions.electrolyte_composition: 1 M LiPF6 in EC/DMC (1:1 by volume)
cell_assembly_conditions.source_text: Polyvinylidene fluoride, acetylene black and HEO were mixed at the weight ratio of 1:1:8, a certain amount of NMP was added, and then applied to the copper foil current collector to form the working electrode. After the coated copper foil dried in a vacuum drying oven (120°C) for 8 h, it was cut into a disc with a diameter of 14 mm and used as electrode for cell assembling in an argon glove box. The electrolyte was 1 M LiPF6 in the mix of ethylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate (1:1 by volume).

electrochemical_test_conditions.source_text: Cyclic voltammetry (CV) tests ranging from 0.01 to 3.0 V were tested on Gamry interface 1010 at 25°C.
